'''Magenta squadron''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:IawMsv" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> the squadron was in mission in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]] when it was ambushed by a group of elite [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE interceptors]] and totally destroyed.<ref name="SWG:DtEIAp" /> As the squadron was missing, [[Havoc Squadron]] was dispatched in the area to investigate the disappearance.<ref name="SWG:IawMsv" /> Havoc Squadron discovered the fate of Magenta squadron and eventually wiped out the group of TIE interceptors.<ref name="SWG:DtEIAp" />

==Behind the scenes==
Magenta squadron was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:IawMsv" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Magenta squadron was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:IawMsv" />
